target.name: Radioactive waste, in interim storage conditioning

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 11.11 'Zusammenstellung der Eingabedaten fuer die Konditionierung radioaktiver Abfaelle im Zwischenlager', column 'radioactive waste, in interim storage conditioning' [CH], per 1 m3; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: No infrastructure of the interim storage itself: that sits in Tab. 11.7/11.8 (per unit of store) and its operation in Tab. 11.9/11.10; this conditioning dataset does not draw on them in the table as printed.

The dataset's includedProcesses mentions 'input of service from the final repository for low active level waste, i.e. the take over of the conditioned waste' - that is the 1.00 m3 of 'radioactive waste, in final repository for nuclear waste LLW' line.
No conditioning matrix (cement, bitumen) and no container material.

The compartment split (air, low population density for the first block; water, river for the second) is taken from the two footer lines of the table because the compartment column itself is not repeated on each row.
skipped_items: transport, lorry 28t: no dataset chosen (No lorry FREIGHT service is offered: the candidate list holds only the disposal and the maintenance of a 28 t lorry (both in units) and vehicle-kilometre operation datasets, none of which is a ton-kilometre transport. The line is reported as missing.)
Dioxins, measured as 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin: no flow chosen (The keyword search returned no candidate for dioxins, so nothing can be chosen.)
